description: Ministry of Public Administration, Management and Law & Order - Notify the amendments to the Minute of Sri Lanka Architects' Service Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1994/68 of 24.11.2016 and the other matters and conditions thereof remain unchanged
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to the service minute (rules/regulations) for the Sri Lanka Architects' Service, specifically addressing qualifications, experience requirements, and selection methods for public service positions. It deals with public service recruitment criteria, service conditions, and merit-based selection processes, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government structure/personnel changes. The content is administrative in nature and issued by the Public Service Commission, focusing on public sector service administration.
